ProductDescription: A cozy setting for two, the Adeline 3-Pack Outdoor set ships complete with two swivel woven chairs and a Side Table. The egg-shaped chairs swivel 360° for a relaxing casual setting on a warm Summer night. There’s no need to worry about the weather with construction that features all-weather resin wicker, powder-coated aluminum frame and Solution-Dyed Acrylic covers. Built to resist the elements and provide the comfort and style you want, all in a fully assembled set. Just unbox and enjoy!

Sophistication meets modern comfort in the Burlington 5-piece 52-inch Round Dining Set. The table boasts a lustrous cocoa finish with muted black accents, complemented by solid wood side chairs featuring tapered tubular legs. The chairs’ durable polyester upholstery ensures easy maintenance, keeping your dining space stylish for years.

 This set seamlessly blends upscale elegance with casual comfort, creating a versatile dining experience. Whether for formal dinners or relaxed meals, the Burlington set enhances any setting with its perfect balance of chic design and relaxed living, making it an essential addition to your home.

A 52-inch round table with a refined rustic style that combines the polish and beauty of a gray marble top with the rustic complement of a white timber-beam trestle base to form the centerpiece of this charming dining room set. White veining in the gray marble table top blends beautifully with the white finished table base and chairs for a harmonious design that seats up to four. The white and gray microfiber chair matches the set in an easy-care and comfortable seat. The casually elegant style of the table will fit beautifully in farmhouse, cottage, ranch or traditional settings and can be paired with the optional Canova Server for a full dining set.

Neutral contemporary style in an outdoor set that will make your patio a showcase. This Sofa looks like it was sculpted for the great outdoors with beveled end panels that frame a modern geometric pattern. And although it looks like an indoor upholstery set, this group is built for the outdoors with rust resistant aluminum frames, solution- dyed acrylics and fast-drying foam cushions.

Rustic charm meets modern elegance in the Grayson Gray Marble Top Counter Dining Set, . to create a dining experience as rich and layered as your favorite vintage wine. A stunning 60-inch table is the centrpiece, with its natural pine offering hidden storage base to keep your dining essentials close at hand, ensuring every gathering flows seamlessly.

 Nestled around the table are six chairs upholstered in a soft, easy-care polyester. Their shield backs offer a cozy embrace, inviting you to linger long after the last bite is savored. The 24-inch counter height fosters intimacy, creating a space for whispered secrets and shared dreams.

 Dine in elegance, linger in comfort. This is the Grayson.

The MollyOlson 5-Piece Dining Collection blends refined style with everyday practicality. The Molly table features a striking wood top paired with white wash base, creating an elegant focal point that elevates any dining setting. Four Olson Side Chairs complement the look with easy-care ,khaki fabric, and for a touch of sophistication. Their flared backs and soft fabric offer both comfort and charm, making the collection a perfect balance of beauty, durability, and modern versatility.

A dining set that is both beautiful and comfortable, Ramona features mid-century modern styling that will instantly update any dining area. This mixed media set features a round white marble top combined with an architecturally shaped dark bronze metal base that is sure to “wow”. The ergonomically shaped faux rawhide chair works well as a dining or guest chair with its comfort and clean lines.

The Sapphire? Mattress makes for the perfect addition to your bedroom for the ultimate sleeping experience. This high-quality mattress offers superior support and a conforming response, thanks to the gel-infused memory foam layer. You’ll wake up feeling refreshed and revitalized, ready to take on the day.

Sit a large crowd outside with the weather- resistant Tamyra sectional!  Resin wicker and solution-dyed fabric covers are stain and fade resistant and built for the outdoors but with the comfort you expect from regular upholstery. 6-inch cushions are ultra-comfortable and removable for when the weather gets bad. The Corner Table features a removable glass top with an umbrella hole and a door on the back for storage. Upholstery with indoor looks but built so you can enjoy the great outdoors!

Sturdy and rustic, the Tyler 38-inch Bar Set delivers a slice of nostalgia mixed with a casual and relaxed design.A glowing rustic Chestnut finish highlights the grain and character of the birch veneers in a distressed application that beautifully accents the powder-coated ebony metal. Storage abounds in the back of the bar for all your serving needs including a hanging stemware rack. The Tyler Counter Stool offers 360 degree swivel with a padded, easy-care black leatherette seat that cleans with the wipe of a damp cloth.  Comfort, style and organization…all delivered with the Tyler Counter Bar Set.

Generously scaled and luxuriously appointed, the Wyatt Chofa takes the indoor styling and comfort of Steve Silver upholstery right to your outdoor patio. This Right-Arm-Facing Chofa offers a relaxing setting for reading or relaxing and is covered in a 100% Solution-Dyed Acrylic cover that is stain and fade resistance. Pair the Wyatt Cocktail with the Chofa or use it alone, the faux- wood finish and mission-style design will make you want to move it inside!
